name: DonorDedupeHouseholding
tagline: One donor, one record, one household – find duplicates with explainable scores, merge with confidence and send every letter to the right household.
description: A complete donor data-quality app for nonprofits in one PCF control: duplicate detection with explainable match scores (nicknames like Bill = William, email, phone, address and postal code, with blocking for large files), a merge workbench with field-by-field survivorship and giving roll-up, bulk merge of high-confidence pairs, not-a-duplicate decisions that never come back, household suggestions from shared addresses with generated formal and informal salutations, household roles and dissolving, and USPS-style address standardisation with leading-zero ZIP repair. Works in canvas apps, model-driven apps and Power Pages, with built-in demo data.
features: Jaro-Winkler name similarity with ~80 built-in nicknames (plus your own)
Email normalisation (case, Gmail dots and +tags), phone digit matching, USPS address keys
Configurable weights, thresholds and survivor rule (giving, oldest, most recent gift, most complete)
Household members and different-gender honorifics kept apart from duplicates
Merge keeps an audit trail: merged record stays with Status Merged and Merged into = survivor
Giving totals, gift counts, first and last dates rolled up on merge
Bulk merge only above a safety threshold; deceased and cross-household pairs need review
Household suggestions, salutation generator, head of household, dissolve with reason
Address standardisation (USPS abbreviations or tidy only), ZIP+4, leading zeros, UK and Canadian postcodes, PO Box detection
Live duplicate check when a contact is created
Undo, CSV export, keyboard shortcuts, notes history
Power Fx outputs and OnSelect / OnChange / OnCreate / OnSave / OnAction / OnStatusChange events
